# ContentHive

> ContentHive is a done-for-you social media content service for trade businesses (plumbers, electricians, heating and cooling, roofers, builders, landscapers). Melbourne based, serving Australia, and New Zealand through its sister company LeadHive NZ. ContentHive films on the tradie's job sites twice a month, edits the footage into reels, stills and posts for TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and YouTube Shorts, and posts every business day. 90 day partnership, monthly fee, no lock-in. Run by Joe Ingram. Contact: hello@leadhivenz.com.

- [Home](https://contenthive.au/)
- [Sister company: LeadHive NZ, exclusive Google Ads leads for tradies](https://leadhivenz.co/)
